objective: Authorize two identical non-learning baseline cells so the V2 receipt-to-metric-to-paired-analysis chain is exercised before algorithm comparisons.
context: This is a chain-validation pair, not an algorithm treatment.
Both arms intentionally use the same resolved configuration, trace seed and acceptance contract.
A zero paired difference is an internal consistency check, not evidence of algorithm quality.
deliverables: Two natural-end V2 receipts bound to the same trace
A persisted V2 paired-analysis manifest and claim gate
cannot_claim: No algorithm superiority or congestion-control effect
No Q0 optimality or paper-ready statistical conclusion
No generalization beyond this exact baseline pair
acceptance: Matrix verifier accepts both cells and exact pairing contract.
Both VM runs use the same clean deployed main SHA and pass natural-end, conservation and acceptance gates.
v2_analysis recomputes delivery_rate from both receipts and persists a VERIFIED analysis whose paired difference is zero.
